title: Ardor backup
text:
Ardor backup overview.

Ardor backup vaults keep snapshots for 90 days by default, with a configurable retention period.

Vault lock can prevent deletion of backups before retention ends.

title: Ardor disaster recovery
text:
Ardor disaster recovery overview. Ardor replicates data to a secondary region for failover, and recovery plans start services in a defined order.

Recovery point objective (RPO): with continuous replication the Ardor RPO is 15 seconds of data loss at most.

Recovery time objective (RTO): Ardor restores service within 300 seconds of a regional failover.

title: Ardor encryption
text:
Ardor encryption overview.

Ardor encrypts data at rest with provider-managed keys held in a managed key service.

Encryption in transit uses TLS for all service endpoints.

title: Ardor pricing
text:
Ardor pricing overview for replication and standby capacity.

Ardor bills cross-region replication at $0.04 per gigabyte transferred; this fee is the main cost of disaster recovery.

Standby compute is charged at the normal hourly rate and idle replicas cost nothing.

title: Ardor regions
text:
Ardor regions overview.

Ardor operates 9 regions, each with at least three availability zones.

Regions are isolated geographic areas connected by low latency links.
